announcements.headline: Ørsted’s financial calendar 2027
announcements.insight: Ørsted published its financial calendar for 2027. This follows the Q3 2026 results presentation scheduled for November.

announcements.headline: Ørsted to present Q3 2026 results on 5 November
announcements.insight: Ørsted schedules its Q3 2026 results presentation for 5 November. This follows the Q2 update in August and the October acquisition of Gunfleet Sands.

announcements.headline: Ørsted to take full ownership of Gunfleet Sands 1 & 2 Offshore Wind Farm in the UK
announcements.insight: Full ownership of Gunfleet Sands 1 & 2 follows recent operational progress. This consolidation strengthens control over UK assets.

announcements.headline: Major shareholder announcement
announcements.insight: Shareholders should monitor this major shareholder announcement for potential changes in ownership structure following recent operational updates.

announcements.headline: Borkum Riffgrund 3 enters commercial operation, strengthening Germany’s energy security with home-grown renewable power
announcements.insight: Commercial operation strengthens energy security. This follows solid operational performance delivered in August.

announcements.headline: Ørsted continues its strategic progress, delivers solid operational performance, and is on track to deliver on its 2026 financial guidance
announcements.insight: Following the Q2 results presentation notice, this update confirms operational performance and progress toward 2026 financial guidance.

announcements.headline: Ørsted to present Q2 2026 results on 13 August
announcements.insight: The company has scheduled its Q2 2026 results presentation for 13 August. Shareholders should watch for this upcoming financial disclosure.
